The issuer exhibits a solid financial profile with substantial total assets ($13,067M), positive equity ($1,997M), a strong retained earnings base ($2,506M), and healthy profitability with net income of $242M on revenues of $1,264M. However, leverage is relatively high, as total liabilities ($10,429M) represent roughly 80% of total assets, which constrains the rating to the investment-grade category rather than high-grade.

DECISION: BBB
